name: LM Studio
removalRules: Model rows retain shared-file grouping. They require review and are not disposable caches. Shared, linked, or open model files stay protected.
note: LM Studio loads a model by opening its file, and `lms import --symbolic-link` links to Hugging Face files, so an open or linked model stays protected.

storage.note: Installs from before LM Studio moved its models use `~/.cache/lm-studio/models`.
